layer1.name: Sidecar
layer1.one_liner: Peer-to-peer ridesharing where drivers set their own prices.
layer1.description: One of the first ridesharing apps, letting private drivers name a price and passengers choose among them. Later added a shared-ride and package-delivery product.
layer1.outcome_note: Ceased operations, with assets later acquired by General Motors. Outspent and out-scaled by two better-funded competitors in the same category. A competitive-wedge failure rather than a demand failure.
